    valuation into CasePage: CaseRoute.tsx:173 renders
    <CasePage {...props} chartData rsFeatures /> with no valuation, and
    caseViewProps.ts:75 doesn't map one either. 11.6.3.12 is a core-side loader,
    not route wiring.

  Probe proof (temporary test, since removed; tree clean): with /api/valuation
  serving valuation_room.json populated mining and features serving the miner
  fixture, through the real CaseRoute:
  • features request carried miner=true ✓, 2 rs-line elements with GLD dashed ✓
  • Valuation tab showed no "Mining valuation" — only
    unknown: valuation not applicable... ✗

  So acceptance (a)'s "populated Valuation room" clause is unsatisfiable
  test-only, while every other acceptance line is. I filed it as needs-decision:
  widen FILES for a one-line route fix, narrow acceptance (a) to assert the
  unknown, or reassign the wiring to the valuation-loader owner first.
